outlook.statement: Medium-to-long-term outlook for the agrochemical sector remains positive, driven by growing global demand for crop protection solutions, increasing focus on food security and farm productivity, shift toward diversified and resilient supply chains, and rising demand for CDMO and contract manufacturing partnerships. The company is well-positioned to capitalize through strong manufacturing base, increasing R&D capabilities, established relationships with global customers, and focus on complex chemistries and differentiated offerings.

Global agrochemical demand expected to witness phased recovery driven by volume growth over next 12-24 months, with continued pricing discipline. Global CDMO market poised to grow at CAGR of 10% up to 2029.

R&D Center projects have increased fivefold since inception, enhancing commercialization of new products with focus on continuous chemistry process and expansion into specialty chemicals and advanced intermediates for pharmaceuticals
Targeting 80% of the total energy consumption through renewable sources by procurement of green power, solar captive projects and phased manner coal elimination.
The Company is also evaluating renewable energy projects such as rooftop solar, ground-mounted solar, captive solar, and hybrid energy systems for its manufacturing facilities.
